board.title: Sounds
board.reconnect: Reconnect Twitch once so darkbot can create rewards for your sounds.
board.onboardText: darkbot listens for channel point redemptions and plays the sound you assign to each reward.
board.emptyText: Assign a sound to one of your channel point rewards.
board.hint: Click a pad to preview it. Viewers trigger it with channel points.
feed.title: Activity
feed.empty: Redemptions appear here as they happen.
feed.queueFull: Too many sounds waiting, not played
settings.title: Settings
general.title: General
general.languageHint: Changes the app right away. The log stays in English so it can be shared in bug reports.
audio.title: Where sounds play
audio.modeDeviceText: darkbot plays the sound on the output you pick. Capture it in OBS.
audio.modeObsText: darkbot plays the sound in an OBS media source on the tracks you pick.
audio.hintChoose: To get it into OBS, pick a virtual cable or spare output and add it as Audio Output Capture. Or keep the default and add darkbot itself with Application Audio Capture.
audio.hintNoChoose: This system doesn’t let darkbot list outputs, so sounds play on the system default. In OBS add darkbot with Application Audio Capture (Windows) or macOS Audio Capture, or choose “Inside OBS”.
audio.tracksHint: Same tracks as in OBS Advanced Audio Properties. Track 1 is usually the stream.
audio.inputHint: Created in the current scene when missing. OBS only plays sources in the active scene, so add it to your other scenes as an existing source.
audio.savedObsOffline: Audio output saved. Connect OBS in the OBS section to play sounds there.
twitch.title: Twitch
twitch.statusOff: Not connected. Connect to let viewers play sounds with channel points.
twitch.statusReconnect: Connected as {login}. Disconnect and connect again so darkbot can create rewards.
twitch.clientIdHint: Create one at dev.twitch.tv/console: client type Public, redirect URL http://localhost. Channel points need an Affiliate or Partner channel.
obs.title: OBS connection
obs.lede: Needed for “Inside OBS”. In OBS open Tools, then WebSocket Server Settings, and enable the server.
obs.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved one
updates.title: Updates
updates.dev: Development build. Builds made on this computer don’t update themselves.
updates.auto: Install updates automatically when darkbot starts
updates.autoHint: While darkbot is running, new versions are only announced, so a stream is never interrupted.
log.title: Log
editor.newHint: darkbot creates this reward on your channel and keeps it in sync. If a sound can’t play, the redemption is rejected so the viewer gets the points back.
editor.existingHint: darkbot only listens to rewards it didn’t create. It can’t change them or give points back.
editor.noRewards: Your channel has no custom rewards yet.
editor.cooldownHint: Nobody can trigger it again during this time.
editor.userCooldownHint: The same viewer has to wait this long.
editor.deleteConfirmReward: Click again, this also deletes the reward on Twitch
play.cannotPlay: the app window could not play this file
play.noSink: choosing an output device is not supported on this system
err.updateRunning: an update is already being installed
err.clientIdFirst: enter your Twitch Client ID first
err.pathAbsolute: the sound file path must be absolute
err.rewardName: the reward name must be 1 to {max} characters
err.price: the price must be between {min} and {max} points
err.reconnect: reconnect Twitch so darkbot may create rewards (Settings, Twitch, Disconnect, Connect)
err.noPlaybackConfirm: no playback confirmation from the app window after {seconds} s
err.tokenRejected: Twitch rejected the login, please connect again
err.notAffiliate: channel points need a Twitch Affiliate or Partner account
err.notOwner: this reward was created outside darkbot, so darkbot can’t change it
err.obsConnect: connect to OBS at {addr} (is OBS running and Tools → WebSocket Server Settings enabled?)
